title: @timed class instrumentation
prompt: Implement the @timed class decorator per the checkpoint spec: wraps every public method, appends per-call durations (seconds, float) to cls.__timings__[name], preserves __name__, skips dunder/private methods, accumulates across instances.

tests.name: public methods are timed, dunders not
tests.code:
s = Service()
s.work(1000)
s.work(50000)
assert 'work' in Service.__timings__, f'timings: {getattr(Service, "__timings__", None)}'
assert len(Service.__timings__['work']) == 2
assert all(isinstance(t, float) and t >= 0 for t in Service.__timings__['work'])
assert '_private' not in Service.__timings__
assert Service.work.__name__ == 'work'
print('ok')
tests.hint: Iterate vars(cls) once, wrap callables whose name does not start with '_', store timings on the CLASS.

tests.name: accumulates across instances; private untouched
tests.code:
Service.__timings__.clear()
Service().work(10)
Service().work(10)
assert len(Service.__timings__['work']) == 2, 'must accumulate across instances'
p = Service()
assert p._private() == 'hidden'
assert '_private' not in Service.__timings__
print('ok')
tests.hint: Timings live on the class attribute, shared by all instances.
